pages.text: A stone in one hand. Something to strike with in the other. $(k:hominin_evolution.item_interact).$(br2)Where you aim decides what you get, at least in theory. The stone has opinions of its own, and soft stone lies about all of them.
The humblest thing a rock can become, and the one that changes everything after it.
pages.title: The First Edge

pages.text: Edges dull - a flake fastest of all. A rough, flat stone in the other hand remembers what a worn edge used to be.
